title: Nick Reiner's attorney removes himself from case
summary: Defense attorney Alan Jackson said that circumstances beyond his and Reiner's control made it "impossible" to continue representation.
contentText:
Spinal Tap II: The End Continues on Tuesday, Sept. 9, 2025, in Los Angeles.'/> Defense attorney Alan Jackson said that circumstances beyond his and Reiner's control made it "impossible" to continue representation.

(Image credit: Richard Shotwell/Invision/AP)
